format: segments: {<party.segment>: {label (Russian chip text), party: default {adults, children} applied with source default for the sub-fields the user did not give (Foundation decision 2), prefs: default prefs (source default, shown as chips), district_weights: {lively, quiet, family, walkable} weights for ranking hotels by OSM district scores (sum 1), jev_criteria: English criterion for Jev segment routing (is this message this segment?), jev_district: English prior for Jev district inference for this segment, cues (optional): lowercase substrings of the user's message that imply this segment when the user named no party, e.g. a business trip -> solo; code assumes the segment with source inferred, shown as a chip}}. With no party said and no cue, the profile's saved travellers give the party (source profile), else questions.json party.segment's recommended choice. Segments not listed (other) use neutral weights 0.25 each and party {adults: 2, children: 0}. district: Russian chip labels and English Jev choice descriptions of the four OSM district labels.

lively.label: движ
lively.jev: Bars, clubs, events and late cafes nearby; noise at night is acceptable.

quiet.label: тихо
quiet.jev: Few bars and little traffic; calm evenings, good sleep.

family.label: семейно
family.jev: Playgrounds, parks, pharmacies and family cafes nearby; safe and calm.

walkable.label: всё пешком
walkable.jev: Sights, cafes and shops within a short walk; no car or taxi needed.

solo.label: один
solo.jev_criteria: One adult travelling alone: 'один', 'одна', 'сам', 'в одиночку'; no partner, children or friends mentioned.
solo.jev_district: A solo traveller usually wants to walk everywhere; choose lively only when the messages mention bars, clubs or parties, quiet when they mention rest or sleep.

couple.label: вдвоём
couple.jev_criteria: Two adults travelling together as a pair: 'вдвоём', 'с женой', 'с мужем', 'с девушкой', 'с парнем', a honeymoon or anniversary; no children.
couple.jev_district: A couple usually wants a quiet area or one where everything is in walking distance; choose lively only when the messages mention nightlife or parties.

family.label: с детьми
family.jev_criteria: Adults travelling with one or more children: 'с ребёнком', 'с детьми', 'с сыном', 'с дочкой', a child's age.
family.jev_district: A family with children needs a family or quiet area (playgrounds, parks, calm nights); never lively unless the parents ask for it explicitly.

friends.label: компанией
friends.jev_criteria: Three or more adults travelling as a group of friends or colleagues: 'с друзьями', 'компанией', 'с коллегами', 'нас трое'; no children.
friends.jev_district: A group of friends usually wants a lively or walkable area; choose quiet only when the messages mention rest, sleep or nature.
